auth.4: Sessiia bassqaru: cookie-lar HttpOnly, Secure jana SameSite atributtaryna ieu bolu kerek.
auth.5: 2FA: qorghanyn ekinshi qabatyn qosed. Parol bolsa da, shabylyushshy ekinshi faktordy qajet etedi.
auth.6: Rate-limiting: brute force shabyldaryn aldyn alady, uaqyt birlikindegi talaptar shekteu arqasynda.

xss.1: Reflected XSS: ziandy skript paidalanushy osal URL-ge baranda oryndalady. Skript juauabda qaitalanyady.
xss.2: Stored XSS: ziandy skript derekter qorghanyna saqtalady jana mazmundy korip jatqan barlyq paidalanushylar ushin oryndalady.
xss.3: DOM-based XSS: klient jaqty JavaScripttegi osaldylyq. Skript DOMdy manipuliiaziia zhapy ziandy kodty oryndaidy.
xss.4: XSS aldyn alu: shygaru kodtau aralyq taubalalary HTML entitylerge ainaladyr. Skript oryndaludyn aldyn alady.
xss.5: CSP taqyrypysy: skript qaunarlaryn shekteidi. Aq tizim approachy ruxsat etilmegen skriptterdi zhukteudi aldyn alady.
xss.6: XSS payload: <script>alert('XSS')</script> negizgi test. Ulkenirek: img onerror, svg onload, t.b.

sql.1: SQL inyektsiiasy: ziandy SQL kody suraua engiziledi. Autentifikatsiianyn aldyndalyp, derekterdi shygaruady.
sql.2: UNION-based: birneshe kestedengi natizhelerdi biriktiredi. Bagandardyn birdeu sanin jana uyimas turlerdin talap etedi.
sql.3: Blind SQL: korinbe shygaru. Uaqyt keudikterin (SLEEP) nemese shartty juauaptardy derekterdi shygaru ushin qoldanyz.
sql.4: SQL aldyn alu: parametrlesken surau SQL kodyn derekterden ayiryp turady. Kiris validatsiiasy jana escaping.
sql.5: ORM qorghau: obekt-aryalyk surnaular kirislerdi avtomatty tushinedi. Validatsiia qajet.
sql.6: Error-based: derekter qoryn shygaratyn derekter qoraly qateleri tudyruady. extractvalue(), updatexml() sekildyi funksiialardy qoldanyz.

csrf.1: CSRF shabyly: qurbanyn autentifikatsiialangan saitta qalausyz amaldardy oryndau'gha mazbur qilady. Sotsial inzhiniiriyany qoldanady.
csrf.2: CSRF tokender: paidalanushy sessiiasymen baylanystan kaidai manny. Durys tokeniz qalmaghan kuyde kuyizge ozgertudi aldyn alady.
csrf.3: SameSite cookie-lar: sait kontekstine qaray cookie zhiberudin shekteidi. Strict/Lax/None rejimderi qalypti basqarady.
csrf.4: Referer tekseru: HTTP Referer taqyrypysyn tekserip, surau sol turymnan kelgenin qamtamasyz etedi. Aylinyp ketu mumkin.
csrf.5: Double Submit Cookie: token cookie-da jana surau parametrinde saqtalady. Server eki manny salystyredy.
csrf.6: CSRF aldyn alu: birneshe qorghany biriktiru - tokenler, SameSite, Origin tekseru, custom taqyryp.
